Hi Samir / Aisha,

Great speaking with you today — appreciate the clear context on the PoC goals (reduce recommendation latency and lower embedding storage costs). Per our call, quick recap and practical next steps so you can get the trial running this week: 

- What we aligned on: 2-week POC, single-store dataset (50k rows), evaluation metrics = 95th pct latency and MRR on re-rank tests.
- Action items for you: provide S3 access details (IAM role or presigned), pick a 2-hour window for an initial pairing session so we can confirm inference endpoints and KV-cache behavior.
- Action items for us: provision a short-lived trial model instance, share trial checklist, and drop an office-hours calendar invite for hands-on setup.

I've attached a one-page trial checklist (redwood-trial-checklist.pdf) — the bolded items are the minimal things we need to unblock setup. If you can share S3 access and a preferred slot (Mon/Tue morning PT preferred by our infra lead), we can get you live.

If priorities shifted and this PoC is lower priority right now, that's totally fine — let me know and we can pause the provisioning until you're ready.

Thanks,
